title: Tarbela Dam
summary: Tarbela Dam is an earth and rock fill dam on the Indus River in Pakistan, built as part of the Indus Basin Project that followed the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty. Its contract was awarded in May 1968; WAPDA records construction from 1968 to 1976, while NASA gives completion as 1977.

uncertainty.note: WAPDA gives completion in 1976; NASA Earth Observatory says 1977.

where.modern_name: Tarbela Dam, Indus River, Pakistan (pin is NASA photo-centre proxy)

importance.justification: A major storage dam on the Indus, built as a replacement work under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.

reviewer_note: Pin is the NASA photo-centre point (34.09 N, 72.70 E), a proxy, not a surveyed dam point. Completion year differs: WAPDA 1976, NASA 1977. The 143 m height lead was not confirmed on an opened institutional page (WAPDA 147.82 m, NASA 147 m), so height is omitted.
